mapper.select: SELECT p.*, d.name AS device_name, d.device_no, u.real_name AS inspector_name FROM inspection_plan p LEFT JOIN device d ON p.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.inspector_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inspection_plan
AND device_id = #{deviceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inspection_plan (device_id, inspector_id, cycle_days, next_inspection_date, status, create_time) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{inspectorId}, #{cycleDays}, #{nextInspectionDate}, #{status}, NOW())
